readings: Among telescopes with bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) of at least 47.6, give for each calibration status (`calibrstatus`) the average bandwidth usage and the number of telescopes.
queries:
SELECT calibrstatus,
       AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
       COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes
WHERE bandusagepct >= 47.6
GROUP BY calibrstatus
